recipes.name: pasta
recipes.title: Simple Olive Oil Pasta 🍝
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Mix spaghetti with oil and garlic, season with salt.

recipes.name: stir_fry
recipes.title: Groundnut Oil Stir Fry 🥦
steps: Heat groundnut oil in a wok.
Add vegetables and stir fry on high heat.
Splash soy sauce, season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: fish_curry
recipes.title: Mustard Oil Fish Curry 🐟
steps: Heat mustard oil until it smokes lightly.
Add onion and sauté until golden.
Add spices and fish pieces, cook gently.
Simmer until fish is tender and curry thickens.
